A group of LEGO minifigures, known as the Master Builders, have the unique ability to build things without instructions. They often gather in the "Dog" section of Cloud Cuckoo Land to discuss various matters. Their creative and unconventional methods have made them a target of Lord Business, who formed the Super Secret Police to track them down. When captured, the Master Builders are taken to the "ymns of Tamil saints."

In medieval era artworks and texts on dancing Shiva found in Nepal, Assam, and Bengal, he is sometimes depicted as dancing on his vahana (animal vehicle) Nandi, the bull. Additionally, Shiva is regionally known as Nartesh.
